why: Every famous name in the results (TechRadar, Tom's Guide) is off-target: VPN service roundups, deals, explainers, home mesh. No major reviewer or authority has tested travel routers with built-in VPN for hotels. The on-topic pages are affiliate listicles and three niche sites (rankedtrue, dobestdeal, wifiweekly) comparing GL.iNet/TP-Link boxes on maker-published WireGuard speeds and owner reviews, with no checkable testing. This looks like the solar-kit win: a focused page with current prices, tested codes and a direct hotel-use pick would stand out.
